_comment: v1.33.0 · 固定收支(#38)+ 立即备份(#29)+ 删除账户(#39)。分两轮拍:A 轮(删之前)= 填报页固定收支一行(展开)· 管理页固定收支清单 · 「示例·旧储蓄卡」的删除面板(PC + 手机上半 / 确认区)· 备份页「立即备份」;中间用浏览器把「示例·旧储蓄卡」删进回收站;B 轮 = 回收站(PC + 手机)· 报表封板抬头的「删除账户…后重算」。固定收支与示例账户的历史是截图前临时造的(金额是编的),截完整库还原。

pc.name: fixed-flows-bar
pc.eval: [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-agent-fab], #agent-fab, #ask-float'), function(e){ e.style.display='none'; }); var b=document.querySelector('[data-ff-box]'); if(b) b.open=true; var el=document.querySelector('[data-fixed-flows]'); window.scrollTo(0, el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 120);

pc.name: delete-panel
pc.eval: [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-agent-fab], #agent-fab, #ask-float'), function(e){ e.style.display='none'; }); var h=document.querySelector('header'); if(h){ h.style.position='static'; } window.scrollTo(0,0);

pc.name: trash
pc.eval: [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-agent-fab], #agent-fab, #ask-float'), function(e){ e.style.display='none'; }); var d=document.querySelector('[data-trash-restore-box]'); if(d) d.open=true; window.scrollTo(0,0);

pc.name: report-trace
pc.eval: [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-agent-fab], #agent-fab, #ask-float'), function(e){ e.style.display='none'; }); var t=document.querySelector('[data-trash-trace]'); var c=t.closest('.paper-card'); c.setAttribute('data-shot','1'); window.scrollTo(0, c.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 140);

pc.name: backup-now
pc.eval: [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-agent-fab], #agent-fab, #ask-float'), function(e){ e.style.display='none'; }); var f=document.querySelector('[data-backup-now]'); var c=f.parentElement.parentElement; c.setAttribute('data-shot','1'); window.scrollTo(0,0);

mobile.name: fixed-flows-row
mobile.eval: var b=document.querySelector('[data-ff-box]'); if(b) b.open=true; var el=document.querySelector('[data-fixed-flows]'); window.scrollTo(0, el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 80);

mobile.name: delete-panel-confirm
mobile.eval: var f=document.querySelector('[data-adel-form]'); window.scrollTo(0, f.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 40); [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('body *'), function(e){ var cs=getComputedStyle(e); if(cs.position==='fixed'){ var r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.top>window.innerHeight-260) e.style.display='none'; } });
